protocol.final_encoder: current compositor libx264 ultrafast default CRF / yuv420p, single final encode
protocol.oracle_scope: controlled video-only oracle with identical explicit encoder threads in every row; not the production auto-thread baseline
protocol.intermediates: FFV1 level 3 yuv444p; never delivery-encoded chunks
protocol.cache: fresh application checkpoint namespace per row; OS page cache uncontrolled
protocol.recovery_limit: persisted shard checkpoints and controlled cancel/reopen demo; no general resume CLI
protocol.counterbalance: cyclic rotation; 3 trials default, not a full Latin square for >3 candidates
protocol.temporal_limit: exact frame slicing after full graph; each shard renders preceding prefix
protocol.timing: render wall includes preparation validation/checkpoint I/O and final encoding, excludes final verification
protocol.assembly: lossless decoded tiles/chunks joined as raw pixels before ONE delivery encode

recovery.mode: controlled stop after finished shard; fresh coordinator; no mid-process kill
